question: Which of the following was the capital of Magadh for several years before it was shifted to Pataliputra?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajgriha.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The core of the area was the **area of Bihar** **south of the Ganges;** its **first capital was Rajagriha**( ultramodern day Rajgir), **also Pataliputra**( ultramodern Patna). 
 
• Pataliputra, conterminous to ultramodern- day Patna, was a megacity in ancient India, firstly erected by Magadha sovereign **Ajatashatru in 490 BCE** as a small stronghold( Pāṭaligrāma) near the Ganges swash.
